name: neo-dsh
description: Neo DSH: my own DeepSeek Harness desktop suite — Electron shell, client plugins, agent preset and the profile they ship with.

scripts.start: node scripts/check-node.mjs && pnpm run resources && pnpm --dir apps/desktop run start
scripts.probe: node scripts/check-node.mjs && pnpm --dir apps/desktop run probe
scripts.pack: node scripts/check-node.mjs && pnpm run resources && pnpm --dir apps/desktop exec electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist:linux: node scripts/check-node.mjs && pnpm run resources && pnpm --dir apps/desktop exec electron-builder --linux --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/check-node.mjs && pnpm run resources && pnpm --dir apps/desktop exec electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/check-node.mjs && pnpm run resources && pnpm --dir apps/desktop exec electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.test: node plugins/activity-line/test/activity.test.mjs && node presets/liangshen/todo-closer.test.mjs && node apps/desktop/test/update-logic.test.mjs && node plugins/desktop-settings/test/settings.test.mjs && node apps/desktop/test/desktop-preferences.test.mjs && node apps/desktop/test/desktop-home.test.mjs && node apps/desktop/test/host-guard.test.mjs && node apps/desktop/test/boot-guard.test.mjs && node apps/desktop/test/proxy-env.test.mjs
